description: This file contains test functions for managing permission schemes in Mattermost, including creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting schemes, as well as testing related error cases and permissions.

methods.name: TestCreateScheme
methods.description: Tests creation of permission schemes, including valid creation, invalid parameters, permission checks, and license restrictions.

methods.name: TestGetScheme
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a specific scheme by ID, including success, not found, bad request, and permission errors.

methods.name: TestGetSchemes
methods.description: Tests listing schemes with filtering by scope, including success, unauthorized, forbidden, and feature flag restrictions.

methods.name: TestGetTeamsForScheme
methods.description: Tests retrieving teams associated with a scheme, including success, not found, invalid ID, and permission errors.

methods.name: TestGetChannelsForScheme
methods.description: Tests retrieving channels associated with a scheme, including success, not found, invalid ID, and permission errors.

methods.name: TestPatchScheme
methods.description: Tests updating schemes with valid patches, partial patches, invalid data, permissions, and license restrictions.

methods.name: TestDeleteScheme
methods.description: Tests deleting schemes, ensuring roles are marked deleted and schemes are disassociated from teams/channels, including error cases.

methods.name: TestUpdateTeamSchemeWithTeamMembers
methods.description: Tests that updating a team's scheme correctly invalidates team member cache and updates roles accordingly.
